title: Seedream 4.0 joins image generation
summary:
Seedream arrived for image generation, GPT-5 Chat gained a model alias, and paid requests got clearer Pollen balance checks.

Three PRs added the seed-tier `seedream` model for text-to-image and reference-image generation. Requests can produce watermark-free images with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. Image analytics now records the options people actually requested, including model and dimensions.

`openai-large` now routes seed-tier requests to GPT-5 Chat and has a `gpt-5-chat` alias. `openai` now aliases `openai-fast` on GPT-4.1 Nano, while `openai-audio` accepts up to 5,000 input characters, up from 2,000. Token-authenticated nanobanana requests have a fixed queue cap.

Enter now checks for an active session and positive Pollen balance before proxying paid text or image requests; free-model requests remain available without that check. Cached responses are not charged, and generation tracking includes cache hits and failed requests. The API also accepts `POST /openai`.

highlights.title: Seedream 4.0 images
highlights.text: Generate images from a prompt or use a reference image with `seedream`. It supports seed-tier access and requests watermark-free output. [Browse Seedream](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).

highlights.title: GPT-5 Chat alias
highlights.text: Seed-tier requests to `openai-large` now use GPT-5 Chat, also available as `gpt-5-chat`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-chat).

highlights.title: Longer audio input
highlights.text: `openai-audio` now accepts up to 5,000 input characters, up from 2,000. [Try the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
